instruction: I need to make the first paragraph more prominent for readability. Please change the font size of all text in the first paragraph to 16 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font size of the entire first paragraph (paragraph index 0) to 16 points. The evaluator checks if all text runs in the specified paragraph have font size set to 16pt. Custom getter reads the DOCX file and extracts font size information for all runs in paragraph index 0, comparing against the target size of 16pt. Verified that paragraph index 0 is the first paragraph in the document.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter function correctly extracts font size information from paragraph 0 (first paragraph) of the DOCX file.

Logic at line 57 correctly treats None font sizes as failures: 'all(size is not None and size == target_size for size in font_sizes)'. This ensures runs with default/unset font size will cause the check to fail.
Evaluator has complete coverage: verifies all text in the first paragraph has font size 16pt, which matches the instruction requirement.
Metric function correctly compares result['all_target_size'] vs expected['all_target_size']. Parameter handling is correct for type='rule' (expected IS the rules dict).
Postconfig appropriately activates the LibreOffice Writer window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) to ensure state persistence before verification.
Edge cases handled: empty paragraph (no runs with text) returns False correctly. Runs with empty text are skipped appropriately.
